derivation: from G4862 (σύν) and the base of G2201 (ζεῦγος);
def: to yoke together, i.e. (figuratively) conjoin (in marriage)

occurrences.text: Wherefore they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder.
